{{Quote|Easy, Kindin. Greetings, gentlebeing Captain. We are here on behalf of Rogun the Butcher. It seems he'd like a word with you.|Xo'ru|<ref name="Chasing Skavak" />}}
'''Xo'ru''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who worked with [[Kindin]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Xo'ru and another hunter named [[Kindin]] traveled to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to capture and bring back the [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] who would later be known as the [[Voidhound]], as the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] had placed a bounty on the smuggler's head for losing a shipment of blasters that belonged to him.<ref name="Chasing Skavak" />

When the smuggler arrived at the docking bay in [[Fort Garnik]], accompanied by [[Corso Riggs]], they were confronted by Xo'ru and Kindin, who too had just arrived. Unwilling to convince the smuggler to come with them, the two groups got into a fight in which both Xo'ru and Kindin were killed.<ref name="Chasing Skavak" />
